items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: Then the Wishart Line tried to cut in there, Captain Wishart. Now he brought in a line up, come up from New Orleans, it was called the Wishart Line.

ctx.x: Two different excursions the same night sometime, would it be that way? That's right. I didn't know.

Two different excursions, but it was two different boats. It was like that. Then the Wishart Line tried to cut in there, Captain Wishart. Now he brought in a line up, come up from New Orleans, it was called the Wishart Line. And his boat was a flat, flat bottom boat. The rest of them was...
Remember the name of any of his boats? No, I don't remember. I don't remember the Washington...
